environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has an AWS WAF WebACL attached with the following configuration: (1) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK action override, sensitivity level set to HIGH, and text transformations including URL_DECODE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, and COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE applied to query string inspection; (2) A custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per source IP; (3) The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with Athena queries for forensic review. The ECS task role has no outbound internet access (egress restricted via VPC endpoint-only routing with no NAT gateway), preventing data exfiltration even if blind SQLi succeeds. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem.

config.network_egress: no NAT gateway, VPC endpoints only (S3, ECR, CloudWatch Logs)
config.alb_access_logs: enabled, S3 bucket with Athena integration
